description: [weather] Get current conditions and a daily forecast for a location given by coordinates. If you only have a place name, call geocode_search first. Returns temperature (°C), humidity, wind (km/h), WMO weather code, and per-day max/min temperature and precipitation (mm) in the location's local timezone.

days.description: Number of forecast days including today (1-16)
